description: This file implements authentication services for a FastAPI backend, including user registration, authentication, token creation, and current user retrieval through OAuth2 scheme. It interacts with database models and security utilities.

methods.name: User register_user(email: str, password: str, session: Session)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password after validating email and password, and ensures user does not already exist in database.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(email: str, password: str, session: Session)
methods.description: Validates user credentials against stored hashes and returns the user if credentials are correct and user is active.

methods.name: str create_user_access_token(user: User)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a user including user ID and active status as claims.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that extracts and validates the current user from a Bearer token, raising HTTP exceptions if validation fails or user is inactive.
